name: 0001_core.sql
statements: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_tokens (hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshots (id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant,id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, submission_key TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, report_key TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, token_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, tokens_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tokens_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deadline INTEGER NOT NULL, error TEXT)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reviews_tenant ON reviews(tenant,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, payload_key TEXT NOT NULL, result_key TEXT, lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_ready ON jobs(status,lease_until)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), event TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_review ON events(review_id,seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), actor TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL, reserved INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, cost_usd REAL, model TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hypotheses (review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(review_id,id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS votes (review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL, voter INTEGER NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(review_id,hypothesis_id,voter))

name: 0002_convergence.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lineages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('pr','branch')), ref TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(generation >= 1), round INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(round >= 0), previous_head TEXT, previous_review TEXT, posted_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', rounds_to_pass INTEGER, intent TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(tenant,repository,kind,ref))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lineage_reviews (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, review_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, round INTEGER, reviewed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, posted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lineage_reviews_generation ON lineage_reviews(lineage_id,generation,seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('agent','tool')), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('new','worsened','pre-existing','fixed','unclassified')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','fixed','dismissed')), round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(round >= 1), first_posted_in TEXT, author_response_json TEXT, resolution_json TEXT, location_json TEXT NOT NULL, finding_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,lineage_id,generation,identity))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS findings_identity ON findings(tenant,identity,updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS findings_repository ON findings(tenant,repository)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feedback (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, finding_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT, note TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
UPDATE feedback SET reason = CASE reason WHEN 'false_positive' THEN 'wrong' WHEN 'known' THEN 'intentional' ELSE reason END WHERE reason IN ('false_positive','known')
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS feedback_next

CREATE TABLE feedback_next (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, finding_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reason IN ('fixed','wrong','intentional','irrelevant','style')), actor TEXT, note TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO feedback_next(id,tenant,finding_id,reason,actor,note,created_at) SELECT id,tenant,finding_id,reason,actor,note,created_at FROM feedback
DROP TABLE feedback
ALTER TABLE feedback_next RENAME TO feedback
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS feedback_finding ON feedback(tenant,finding_id)

name: 0003_snapshot_contents.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contents (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, pack TEXT NOT NULL, offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(offset >= 0), size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size >= 0), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,hash))
